author: C.L.Brehm, 1831

months.note: 10월에 와서 이듬해 4월까지 머물며, 동해안에서는 수백 마리가 모이기도 한다.

summary: 전국에서 볼 수 있는 비교적 흔한 겨울철새로, 강 하류나 해안 호수에서 무리 지어 지낸다. 종종 수십 마리가 무리를 이루어 잇달아 물속으로 잠수하며 어류, 갑각류, 복족류, 곤충을 잡아먹는다. 유럽에서 카자흐스탄, 중국 동북부에서 우수리, 북아메리카 중부, 아프리카 동부 등지에서 번식하고, 유럽, 중동, 동아시아, 중남미, 아프리카 남부에서 겨울을 난다.
young: 어린새는 어른새 겨울깃과 비슷하나 몸 윗면이 더 갈색을 띠고 뒷목 옆에 황갈색 기가 돌며, 머리의 흑백 경계가 더 흐릿하다. 멱은 희고 앞목과 윗가슴은 칙칙한 회색이다.

similar.how: 겨울깃에서 검은목논병아리는 검은색이 눈 아래 뺨까지 흐릿하게 번지고 부리가 가늘며 위로 들린 듯 보이지만, 귀뿔논병아리는 검은 머리꼭대기와 흰 뺨의 경계가 눈높이에서 또렷하고 부리가 곧고 굵다.

art.subject: Black-necked Grebe (Podiceps nigricollis), adult in winter (non-breeding) plumage, as seen on Korean estuaries from November to March: black cap reaching down below the eye onto the ear-coverts, the dark grading into the cheek rather than cut sharply; white throat and a white crescent curving up behind the ear-coverts; foreneck washed dusky grey; hindneck and back blackish-grey; flanks grey; underparts white. Thin black bill with an upturned lower edge, appearing slightly tilted up; bright red eye; dark grey legs.
art.pose: swimming in a loose flock on open water, side view, head held up
art.scene: Korean winter river mouth with a wide, calm channel near the coast; no people, buildings or text
views: adult winter, side view swimming: peaked crown, black cap extending below the red eye, white throat and crescent behind the ear-coverts, dusky foreneck, dark back, grey flanks, thin upturned black bill
adult winter, head detail in side view: steep forehead and peaked crown, bright red eye, thin black bill with an upturned lower edge
adult breeding (spring), side view swimming: black head and neck, golden fan of plumes behind the eye, chestnut flanks, red eye, upturned black bill
art.build: Small grebe, about 31cm, a little larger than Little Grebe and smaller than a Mallard; neat, with a thin neck, steep forehead and a peaked crown highest above the eye. Bill black and thin, shorter than the head, with a straight upper edge and an upturned lower edge giving a slightly upturned look. Legs set at the rear of the body. Rides fairly high with a fluffed rear; often in flocks that dive one after another.
avoid: Do not paint a flat crown, a straight bill with a pale tip or white cheeks sharply cut from the black cap; that is Horned Grebe (Podiceps auritus).
Do not show golden ear plumes or chestnut flanks in the winter scene; they are breeding plumage.
Do not paint a yellow eye (Little Grebe) or a long pink bill (Great Crested Grebe).
